newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Stanley heads earned hefty 96 pay - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley heads earned hefty 96 pay - NYT.

text.p: Three top officers at Morgan Stanley Group Inc each earned more than $10 million last year, the New York Times reported Friday.
The paper said Chairman Richard Fisher made $10.5 million in bonuses, restricted stock and salary in the firm's financial year, which ended November 30.
President John Mack made $10.7 million, mostly in bonuses and restricted stock, and Peter Karches, who heads the company's securities business, earned $10.1 million, the report said.
The report said the salaries were disclosed in Morgan Stanley's filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
